title: Rivercity Players Stage

services.name: Facility Rental
services.desc: The Rivercity stage has seating for 96. We are wheelchair friendly! The proscenium (arch around the stage) is 30 feet wide and 10 feet tall and the depth behind proscenium is approximately 16 feet. We have professional grade sound and lighting systems controlled from our tech booth (centre rear). On the entrance side (left in the above view) there is a large 24 x 30 foot lobby, with about a quarter set aside for a refreshment counter. On the right side are doors to three washrooms; Men's, Ladies and Accessible (there is also a washroom behind the stage for actors). The building is wheelchair
